title: Obstacle Course Challenge
goal_description: Investigate navigation safety and propose a supervised research mission.

hypotheses.title: Increasing Repulsion Gain
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will reduce the likelihood of collisions by making the robot more responsive to obstacles.
hypotheses.mechanism: The repulsion gain parameter controls how strongly the robot avoids obstacles. A higher gain means the robot will move away from obstacles more aggressively.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Safety Margin
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to navigate closer to obstacles, potentially increasing the speed and efficiency of the robot.
hypotheses.mechanism: The safety margin parameter defines the distance the robot maintains from obstacles to ensure safe navigation. A smaller margin means the robot can operate in tighter spaces.
